speaker: sheldon_cooper
text: Wolowitz is trying to outflank us. Let out some string, add altitude and I'll go under and cut his line.

speaker: leonard_hofstadter
text: Why wouldn't Penny want her friends to meet me?

speaker: sheldon_cooper
text: Focus, Leonard, focus! The heat of battle is upon us, the dogs of war are unleashed.

speaker: leonard_hofstadter
text: Maybe Koothrappali's right, maybe I embarrass her.

speaker: sheldon_cooper
text: You're embarrassing me right now, a grown man worrying about such nonsense when in the middle of flying kites.

speaker: leonard_hofstadter
text: Sorry.

speaker: sheldon_cooper
text: Sorry won't bring their kites down. Ow! String burn! String burn!

speaker: raj_koothrappali
text: Oh, they think we're flanking, they're playing right into our hands. On the count of three, we execute the flying scissor. One, two...

speaker: howard_wolowitz
text: Whoa! Did you see that? That chick, she smiled at me. Yes, she did. Hold my line.

speaker: raj_koothrappali
text: See what?

speaker: raj_koothrappali
text: No, she didn't. Come on, scissors, scissors! Wait, what are you doing? I can't scissors by myself! Howard! Come back!

speaker: sheldon_cooper
text: Victory!

speaker: raj_koothrappali
text: Son of a bitch. You're a sucky friend, you know that? A sucky, sucky friend.

speaker: howard_wolowitz
text: What was I supposed to do? She gave me that come-hither look.

speaker: raj_koothrappali
text: If she gave you any look at l. It was a you suck look.

speaker: howard_wolowitz
text: I would've caught up to her if I hadn't pulled a hammy.

speaker: raj_koothrappali
text: Oh, please, you weigh 80 pounds. You don't have a hammy.

speaker: leonard_hofstadter
text: So, Penny doesn't want me around her friends, I embarrass her. What else could it be?

speaker: sheldon_cooper
text: Well, her actions could be out of concern for your feelings. Perhaps she's excluded you from these gatherings because she's scouting for a new mate and doesn't want to do it in front of you.

speaker: leonard_hofstadter
text: Oh, how kind of her.

speaker: sheldon_cooper
text: Agreed. Most primates don't show that sort of discretion. A female bonobo will copulate with a new male in front of the old one without so much as a how do you do?

speaker: raj_koothrappali
text: You always do this, you know? You ditch me for a woman you don't have a shot with. With a woman you were chasing through a park? That's not a shot, that's a felony. What's worse, it cost me my prized Patang fighting kite. Sheldon, I don't suppose there's any chance you could give me my kite back?

speaker: howard_wolowitz
text: I totally had a shot.

speaker: sheldon_cooper
text: I'm sorry, Raj, but the rules of aerial warfare dictate at the fallen kite go to the victor. And without rules, the competition has no meaning. And without meaning, the following would be an empty gesture. I have your kite. I have your kite.
